# teamcity_auth_settings (Resource)

TeamCity can authenticate users via an internal database, or can integrate into your system and use external authentication sources such as Windows Domain, LDAP, or Git hosting providers. More details [here](https://www.jetbrains.com/help/teamcity/configuring-authentication-settings.html)

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "teamcity_auth_settings" "settings" {
  allow_guest             = true
  guest_username          = "guest"
  welcome_text            = ""
  collapse_login_form     = false
  per_project_permissions = true
  email_verification      = true

  modules = {
    token = {}
    basic_http = {}

    github = {
      create_new_users = true
      organizations    = "org1,org2"
    }

    # Escape hatch for auth modules with no dedicated attribute above, such as
    # plugin-provided modules (e.g. the SAML plugin's "HTTP-SAML.v2"). `name` must
    # be the raw TeamCity auth-module name — check Administration > Authentication
    # Modules, or the server's auth-config.xml, to find it. Without an `others`
    # entry, a module not modeled by this provider is silently dropped from the
    # server on every apply, because the full module list is replaced on update.
    others = [
      {
        name = "HTTP-SAML.v2"
        # properties are optional and module-specific; check the module's own
        # settings storage / the TeamCity REST API for the exact property names.
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

Optional:

- `jetbrains_space` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--modules--jetbrains_space))
- `ldap` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--modules--ldap))
- `others` (Attributes List) Escape hatch for auth modules with no dedicated attribute above (for example plugin-provided modules such as the SAML plugin's 'HTTP-SAML.v2'). Without an entry here, TeamCity auth modules that this provider does not model are silently removed on every apply, because the whole module list is replaced on update. 'name' must be the raw TeamCity auth-module name (as seen in Administration > Authentication Modules / auth-config.xml), not a display name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--modules--others))

### Nested Schema for `modules.others`

Required:

- `name` (String) Raw TeamCity auth-module name, e.g. 'HTTP-SAML.v2'. Must not collide with a module already covered by a dedicated attribute (token, built_in, basic_http, google, github_app, github, github_enterprise, ldap, jetbrains_space).

Optional:

- `properties` (Map of String) Module-specific properties as returned/accepted by the TeamCity REST API for this module.
